judgment.heading: Suggested routines
judgment.ask: Propose at most 3 new relay routines (id, kind, schedule, what it checks, which repeated action it replaces) from the repeated launches below. One line each: `- <id> · <passive|active> · <days> <HH:MM> · <what it checks> · replaces <action>`, days as mon,tue,… Answer "none" when nothing repeats.
